_comment: Declarative source config. Verify each FeatureServer URL on the hub site before a full run: open the dataset page, 'I want to use this' -> 'API' -> copy the FeatureServer layer URL (ends in /FeatureServer/0 or /MapServer/N). Field names below are mappings from source schema -> pipeline schema; if the source schema drifts, fix it here, not in code.

parcels.name: LA County Assessor Parcels (search 'Assessor Parcels' on egis-lacounty.hub.arcgis.com)

city_boundary.name: City Boundary of Los Angeles (geohub.lacity.org, search 'City Boundary')

vhfhsz.name: Fire Hazard Severity Zones (geohub.lacity.org 'Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zone' or CAL FIRE FRAP FHSZ; keep the hazard-class field)

vacancy._comment: A parcel counts as vacant if its use code is in vacant_use_codes (prefix match) OR (units == 0 AND improvement value < improvement_value_max). County use codes starting with these prefixes are vacant land categories.

sb1123._comment: Thresholds in sqft. SF: 1.5 ac (SB 1123 vacant single-family lots). MF: 5 ac (SB 684 multifamily-zoned lots). Fire: High(1) and Very High(2) both disqualify.

subsets._comment: A subset is one bbox [minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat] or a list of bboxes (downloaded sequentially; 02_enrich dedupes parcels by AIN where boxes overlap).
